enhancedPrompt.productVision: To create a comprehensive dashboard that empowers educators, system leaders, and policymakers to measure and improve student outcomes, system responsiveness, and institutional effectiveness through data-driven insights and actionable frameworks.
enhancedPrompt.targetUsers: Educators, school administrators, system leaders, policymakers, and education researchers.
personas: School Principal: Focused on improving student retention and learning outcomes.
District Education Officer: Interested in system-level improvements and policy changes.
Education Researcher: Needs detailed data for analysis and reporting.
coreFeatures: Interactive dashboards for each framework (ERLAW, ALIVE, PACE/SCALE).
userStories: As a school principal, I want to track student attendance rates so that I can identify and address dropout issues.
As a district education officer, I need to monitor budget utilization to ensure resources are allocated effectively.
As an education researcher, I want to analyze foundational literacy data to support policy recommendations.
As a system leader, I need to view collaboration metrics to enhance cross-department coordination.
As a policymaker, I want to see policy adoption rates to measure the impact of new guidelines.
userFlows: User logs in > Navigates to Student Outcomes Dashboard > Views Enrollment Rates > Generates Report.
User logs in > Navigates to System Leader Impact Dashboard > Reviews Leadership Metrics > Shares Insights with Team.
User logs in > Navigates to Institutional Framework Dashboard > Checks Policy Influence > Downloads Data for Presentation.
enhancedPrompt.architecture: Modular architecture with separate modules for each framework, integrated through a central dashboard. RESTful API for data exchange and third-party integrations.
enhancedPrompt.database: Relational database (e.g., PostgreSQL) with tables for each framework's indicators, user data, and reports. Data warehousing for historical analysis.
uxRequirements: Responsive design for mobile, tablet, and desktop.
Intuitive navigation and clear content hierarchy.
edgeCases: Data entry errors leading to incorrect metrics.
Network issues causing delayed data updates.
User access permissions not correctly configured.
acceptanceCriteria: Reports can be generated and downloaded in multiple formats.
User feedback indicates ease of use and satisfaction.
successMetrics: Increased user engagement (measured by login frequency).
Improved student outcomes (tracked through ERLAW indicators).
Positive feedback from stakeholders on usability and impact.
risks: Technical issues causing downtime or data loss.

prd.title: Comprehensive Education Dashboard PRD
prd.overview: This product aims to empower educators, system leaders, and policymakers with a comprehensive dashboard to measure and improve student outcomes, system responsiveness, and institutional effectiveness through data-driven insights and actionable frameworks.
goals: Provide actionable insights to improve student outcomes.
Enable real-time tracking of educational metrics.
prd.targetAudience: Educators, school administrators, system leaders, policymakers, and education researchers.

userPersonas.name: Principal John
painPoints: Lack of real-time data on student attendance.
behaviors: Collaborates with teachers to address issues.

features.name: Interactive Dashboards
features.description: Interactive dashboards for each framework (ERLAW, ALIVE, PACE/SCALE).

userStories.title: Track Student Attendance
userStories.description: As a school principal, I want to track student attendance rates so that I can identify and address dropout issues.
acceptanceCriteria: Ability to filter attendance data by grade and class.

userStories.title: Monitor Budget Utilization
userStories.description: As a district education officer, I need to monitor budget utilization to ensure resources are allocated effectively.
acceptanceCriteria: Report shows budget allocation vs. utilization.

userStories.title: Analyze Foundational Literacy Data
userStories.description: As an education researcher, I want to analyze foundational literacy data to support policy recommendations.
acceptanceCriteria: Ability to download data for further analysis.

userStories.title: View Collaboration Metrics
userStories.description: As a system leader, I need to view collaboration metrics to enhance cross-department coordination.
acceptanceCriteria: Ability to share insights with team members.

userStories.title: Measure Policy Adoption Rates
userStories.description: As a policymaker, I want to see policy adoption rates to measure the impact of new guidelines.
acceptanceCriteria: Ability to compare adoption rates across regions.

constraints: Ensuring accessibility for users with disabilities.
prd.timeline: Q1: Requirement Gathering, Q2: Design and Prototyping, Q3: Development, Q4: Testing and Launch
